item.title: Welcome - Get to Know Me
item.dc:creator: Jack Chen
item.description:
Hello wanderer(s),

My name is Jack and I’d like to start this new endeavor with a short bit about my background. I currently work as an investigational drug services clinical pharmacist, but have had the pleasure of practicing within the acute care continuum since becoming a licensed pharmacist in 2021. While I started at an emergency medicine-heavy PGY-1, working at one of the nation’s best NCI-designated cancer centers, Memorial Sloan Kettering, solidified my interest in serving our hematology/oncology population. In between all these opportunities, the spotlight on drug development during the COVID-19 pandemic and my analytical nature guided me towards the quantitative sciences, in which I recently completed my Master’s in Pharmacometrics and Personalized Pharmacotherapy at the University at Buffalo School of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences (UBSPPS).

The last 2 years have been challenging yet invigorating, building my skills within model-informed drug development and the complex intersection of mathematics, statistics, coding, and pharmaceutical sciences that is pharmacometrics. While my professional experience lags behind at the moment, there is no contention that the quantitative PKPD principles taught at UBSPPS come from leaders in this field (e.g. Dr. Mager, Dr. Jusko, Dr. Bies, et al).

In the future, I hope this blog serves as a reminder of where I started and where I’ll go - as of now, it’ll be representing UBSPPS as an proud alumnus.
